name: Dresser hot-spring microbes
fact: Signs of microbes in the rock of hot springs that bubbled on land in the Pilbara of Western Australia — perhaps the oldest signs of life on land.

name: Strelley Pool stromatolites
fact: A reef of stromatolites of many shapes — cones, domes, egg-crate patterns — built by microbes in a shallow sea 3.43 billion years ago, in what is now Western Australia.

name: Moodies river mats
fact: Wrinkled mats of microbes preserved beside old rivers in South Africa, 3.22 billion years old: life on land.
